subject: english
question: Based on the given passage, which of the following inferences can be made?

options.text: The discovery of the Sapphire-winged Warbler has sparked global interest in birdwatching.
The Sapphire-winged Warbler is an aggressive and territorial bird species.
Conservation efforts are solely focused on protecting the Sapphire-winged Warbler.
The scientific community has lost interest in studying avian species.

solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1 **i.e. *The discovery of the Sapphire-winged Warbler has sparked global interest in birdwatching.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **passage mentions** that the discovery of the Sapphire-winged Warbler has sparked excitement among ornithologists and bird enthusiasts worldwide, indicating a global interest.
 
• **Birdwatchers and nature enthusiasts** flocking to the island further support the inference of increased interest in birdwatching.

Therefore, the correct answer is "The discovery of the Sapphire-winged Warbler has sparked global interest in birdwatching."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** The Sapphire-winged Warbler is an aggressive and territorial bird species. This is not supported by any information in the passage.
 
• **Option 3: **Conservation efforts are solely focused on protecting the Sapphire-winged Warbler. While conservation efforts are mentioned, the passage does not state that they are solely focused on this species.
 
• **Option 4: **The scientific community has lost interest in studying avian species. The passage describes active research and interest, contradicting this statement.
